title: Answer: takes no position on a fundamental substance, starts from persisting systems

statements.text: IWMT takes no position on what the world is made of. Its starting point is the free energy principle: persisting systems must embody predictive models to resist entropic mixing. On that view every persisting thing has mind-like qualities, which makes the framework panprotopsychist but not panpsychist.

sources.quote: The Free Energy Principle states that persisting systems must entail predictive models to resist entropic mixing
both IWMT and FEP-AI could be viewed as panprotopsychist
